components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
The RSV preF A and RSV preF B recombinant proteins are expressed in genetically engineered Chinese
Hamster Ovary cell lines grown in suspension culture using chemically-defined media, without antibiotics or
animal-derived components.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
After reconstitution, a single dose of ABRYSVO is formulated to contain 120 mcg of RSV stabilized prefusion
F proteins (60 mcg RSV preF A and 60 mcg RSV preF B) per 0.5 mL. ABRYSVO also contains the following
buffer ingredients: 0.11 mg tromethamine, 1.04 mg tromethamine hydrochloride, 11.3 mg sucrose, 22.5 mg
mannitol, 0.08 mg polysorbate 80, and 1.1 mg sodium chloride per 0.5 mL.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
The Act-O-Vial stoppers, vial stoppers and tip cap and rubber plunger of the prefilled syringe are not made with
natural rubber latex.

dismissed.egg: 命中皆為 'embryo-fetal'／'embryo/fetal'（動物生殖毒理學研究用詞，如 embryo-fetal developmental toxicity study），與蛋／雞胚無關
dismissed.aluminium: p17 命中為同時併用的另一廠牌流感疫苗 'FLUAD QUADRIVALENT (Adjuvanted)'；p29 命中為 14.5 節第二期臨床試驗中一款「with or without Al(OH)3」的研究用調製劑，非上市核准配方——核准配方見 Description(11)，未列鋁佐劑

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote:
Do not administer ABRYSVO to individuals with a history of a severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) to
any component of ABRYSVO [see Description (11)].
